guard: setup takes its inputs from a terminal or from flags, refuses a missing one and Cloud before any write, prepares or registers the space at the project, seeds the default persona where spawn reads it, records the application as the space's harness preference, sets up only the runtimes chosen and never removes one, and changes nothing on a rerun
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... --filter @cotal-ai/tmux --filter @cotal-ai/herdr build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/setup-destination.smoke.ts
why: Each mutation removes one refusal setup makes before it writes, one place the preparation lands, one runtime rule, or one terminal behavior. The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
